fact: The interior ministry's civil-status page of 29 February 2024 states that births and deaths are declared to the commune where they occur, that the acts are issued at any commune or administrative annex in the country and over the internet, and that a data-entry error ("erreur de saisie") is rectified by the civil-status officer whereas an error made in transcribing the act onto the civil-status register goes to the courts.
title: Etat civil ( Acte de naissance/ Acte de mariage/ Acte de décès/ Livret de famille/ Fiche Familiale)
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités locales et des Transports
